declared_before_scoring: 2026-11-17; before all SAP task metrics; source and adapter probes only.
scope: Seven contact tasks common to SAP, MuJoCo Warp, Genesis Rigid and IPC a3. Ball bounce excluded consistently with IPC user decision; socket is a separately declared draft pilot.
selection_policy: Same as the task manifest: B=1 = Genesis native defaults; candidates 2-5 below are fixed now; select on selection cells only with the task's existing gate/loss/wall-time rule; freeze; run the unchanged held-out matrix with R=20.

candidate_rules.B1: SAPCouplerOptions() untouched; physical mass, inertia, gravity, dt and friction from original manifests.
candidate_rules.B5: Native plus four fixed hydroelastic stiffness/dissipation settings; all nonnative use 20 SAP iterations; no heldout tuning.
candidate_rules.friction: floor reads body coup_friction; rigid pairs sqrt(mu_a*mu_b); MIT pusher mu=.25^2/.22.

tasks.mapping: Independent SAP-native settings; no mapping of MuJoCo solref to hydroelastic modulus.

amendments.change: Candidates with noslip>0 use cone=pyramidal instead of the elliptic default of the non-native settings.
amendments.reason: Genesis 1.4.6 raises 'The elliptic friction cone is not supported with the noslip solver.' at build. Only engine-imposed; at the time of the change the only scored output was three-box candidate 1 (native default, unaffected) and pinch candidate 1 (native default, unaffected). Both tasks are rerun in full under this revision.
